Answer: A
Reason: The chest radiograph demonstrates multiple small, well-defined nodular opacities scattered randomly throughout both lung fields, with some appearing dense/calcified. This pattern is characteristic of healed varicella pneumonia granulomas, whereas the other options describe findings (cavitation, large mass, reticular shadowing, or alveolar infiltrates) that are not present in this image.
